text:
in brief cárcel traigo aprisionado,
with all his familia of gold ardiente,
the cerco of the light resplandeciente,
and great imperio of the love cerrado.


Traigo the campo that pacen estrellado
the fieras altas of the piel luciente,
and a escondidas of the sky and of the Oriente,
day of light and parto mejorado.


Traigo all the Indias in my hand,
perlas that in a diamante por rubíes
pronuncian with desdén sonorous hielo;


and razonan tal vez fire tirano,
relámpagos of laughter carmesíes,
auroras, gala and presunción of the sky.

translation.title: in brief cárcel traigo aprisionado
